certificate_mismatch.title: Door station certificate changed
certificate_mismatch.description: The certificate of the door station no longer matches the stored fingerprint. No unlock events are processed until this is resolved. If the certificate was changed intentionally, remove and set up the integration again.

clock_drift.title: Door station clock is off
clock_drift.description: The clock of the door station differs from Home Assistant by {seconds} seconds. Unlock events may be missed or delayed. Please correct the time on the door station.
